title: 第25章 难道他还活着第26章 震撼一波接着一波
slug: 先秦炼气两千年世人误闯天家
content_zh:
金世昌顿了顿，说出了一个让所有人汗毛倒竖的猜测，“除非，他要祭祀的，根本不是天。他要沟通的，也不是什么上天。”
“那是什么？”
冰冰追问道。
金世昌没有回答，只是死死地盯着屏幕。
林薇没有犹豫，她对着身后的队员们点了点头，率先踏上了第一层台阶。
就在她的脚接触到台阶的瞬间。
“嗡——”整座祭坛，连同整个大殿的地面，那些细微的符文和纹路，瞬间被点亮！
一道道金色的光芒，如同奔涌的潮水，顺着地面的“电路”，从四面八方汇聚而来，涌入祭坛。
然后，光芒顺着九层台阶，层层递进，盘旋而上！
最终，所有的光芒，都汇聚到了祭坛的最顶端！
在那里，一束璀璨夺目的金色光柱，冲天而起，直通穹顶的星海！
而在这束光柱之中，一个物体的轮廓，缓缓地显现了出来。
那是一口……
通体温润，泛着莹莹宝光，由一整块美玉雕琢而成的……
玉棺！
当那口玉棺在金色光柱中显现出来时，整个世界都被按下了静音键。
它静静地悬浮在光柱之中，周身环绕着点点星辉，玉质温润，散发着超越凡俗的圣洁与祥和。
它不用来盛放死人的棺椁，反而更一件孕育着神明与生命的艺术品。
“玉……玉棺……”
考古专家张建国教授的声音都在发抖，他指着屏幕，激动得语无伦次：“这……这是什么玉？通体无暇，浑然一体，还……还会发光！我研究了一辈子古玉，从未见过，甚至从未听说过这样的神物！”

【这就是棺材？骗我的吧！这比我家传家宝那个翡翠镯子漂亮一万倍！】
【悬浮的玉棺！还会发光！这画面我能在任何一部电影里看到，但绝不应该是在考古直播里看到！】
【我彻底投降了，从现在开始，谁跟我讲科学我跟谁急！这他妈就是神仙的棺材！】
【淮南王刘安，你到底是个什么存在啊！】
全网的观众，已经彻底放弃了用常理去思考。
他们只是睁大了眼睛，贪婪地看着这颠覆三观的一幕，将每一个细节都深深地烙印在自己的脑海里。
现场，林薇和队员们也被这突如其来的变故惊得停下了脚步。
他们能清晰地感觉到，随着祭坛被激活，周围的空气中似乎多了说不清道不明的东西。
吸入肺里，让人感觉神清气爽，连日来的疲惫都一扫而空。
“陈博士，快！分析这里的能量读数！”
林薇立刻想到了什么，对着通讯器喊道。
演播厅里，陈振博士早已被眼前的一幕惊得说不出话来，听到林薇的呼叫，他才如梦初醒，连忙低头看向手中的探测仪。
只看了一眼，他的瞳孔便骤然一缩。
“爆表了！能量读数……爆表了！”
他失声喊道，“这里的能量浓度，是外面的数万倍！不，是数十万倍！而且……而且这种能量，对人体……无害，甚至有益！天啊，这简直就是一个天然的……生命能量场！”
他的话，让所有人又是一惊。
【生命能量场？这是什么概念？跟游戏里的回血光环一样吗？】
【难怪林队他们看起来精神那么好，原来是在“充电”啊！】
【我要去！我要去这个地方！待上一年是不是能多活十年？】
【楼上的想多了，没看之前队员都被震飞了吗？这地方可不是谁都能进的。】

就在这时，直播间里，一条被无数人点赞的弹幕，被顶到了最显眼的位置。
content_en:
Jin Shichang paused and made a guess that made everyone's hair stand on end, "Unless what he wants to sacrifice is not God at all. What he wants to communicate with is not God."
"What's that?"
Bingbing asked.
Jin Shichang didn't answer, just stared at the screen.
Lin Wei did not hesitate. She nodded to the team members behind her and took the lead in stepping onto the first step.
The moment her feet touched the steps.
"Buzz--" The entire altar, as well as the entire floor of the hall, those subtle runes and patterns were instantly lit up!
Rays of golden light, like rushing tides, followed the "circuit" on the ground, gathered from all directions, and poured into the altar.
Then, the light spiraled upwards along the nine steps, layer by layer!
Finally, all the light gathered at the top of the altar!
There, a dazzling golden beam of light rose into the sky and reached the sea of ​​​​stars on the dome!
In this beam of light, the outline of an object slowly appeared.
That's a bite...
The whole body is moist and glowing with precious light, carved from a single piece of beautiful jade...
Jade coffin!
When the jade coffin appeared in the golden light pillar, the whole world was pressed on the mute button.
It floats quietly in the pillar of light, surrounded by dots of stars. The jade quality is warm and moist, exuding holiness and peace that transcend the ordinary.
It is not used to hold the coffin of the dead, but is more of a work of art that nurtures gods and life.
"Jade... jade coffin..."
Archaeological expert Professor Zhang Jianguo's voice was trembling. He pointed at the screen and spoke incoherently with excitement: "This... what kind of jade is this? It's flawless, integrated, and... it also shines! I have studied ancient jade all my life, and I have never seen or even heard of such a divine object!"
[This is the coffin? Lie to me! This is 10,000 times more beautiful than the jade bracelet that is my heirloom! 】
[The suspended jade coffin! It will also shine! I can see this scene in any movie, but it should never be seen in an archaeological live broadcast! 】
[I have completely surrendered. From now on, I will be in a hurry with anyone who talks to me about science! This is the fucking coffin of a god! 】
[Huainan King Liu An, what kind of existence are you! 】
The entire audience on the Internet has completely given up thinking with common sense.
They just opened their eyes wide, greedily watching this scene that subverted their three views, and deeply imprinted every detail in their minds.
At the scene, Lin Wei and the team members were also shocked by the sudden change and stopped.
They could clearly feel that as the altar was activated, there seemed to be something inexplicable in the air around them.
Inhaling it into the lungs makes people feel refreshed and the fatigue of the past few days is swept away.
"Dr. Chen, hurry! Analyze the energy readings here!"
Lin Wei immediately thought of something and shouted into the communicator.
In the studio, Dr. Chen Zhen was shocked speechless by the scene in front of him. When he heard Lin Wei's call, he woke up as if from a dream, and quickly lowered his head to look at the detector in his hand.
After just one glance, his pupils suddenly shrank.
"It's off the charts! The energy reading... is off the charts!"
He shouted out loud, "The energy concentration here is tens of thousands of times that outside! No, it's hundreds of thousands of times! And...and this energy is...harmless to the human body, even beneficial! Oh my god, this is simply a natural...life energy field!"
His words shocked everyone again.
[Life energy field? What is this concept? Is it the same as the blood regeneration halo in the game? 】
[No wonder Team Lin and the others look so energetic, they are "recharging"! 】
【I want to go! I want to go to this place! Will staying there for one year add ten years to your life? 】
[The people upstairs are thinking too much. Didn’t you look at the previous team members and were they knocked away? Not everyone can enter this place. 】
Just then,In the live broadcast room, a barrage that was liked by countless people was pushed to the most prominent position.
